note: Official documents retrieved from iibf.org.in. Copies are kept locally under content/sources/iibf/ (not committed); this registry records where they came from and their SHA-256 fingerprints. Facts taken from them are listed under `established`.

sources.title: CAIIB Rules & Syllabus 2026
sources.document_date_basis: PDF creation metadata and the date in the file name; the title page says "Rules & Syllabus 2026"
sources.session_applicability: CAIIB 2026 (the page that links it lists the May/June 2026 and December 2026 examinations)
sources.note: Covers all four compulsory and all five elective papers. Syllabus on PDF pages 5-26.
established: PDF p.1: four compulsory papers and five electives; candidates choose one elective and may change it in any attempt.
PDF p.1: pass mark 50 out of 100 per subject; or at least 45 in each subject with 50% aggregate across all subjects in a single attempt.
PDF p.3: about 100 objective multiple-choice questions for 100 marks including case-based questions; the Institute may vary the number of questions.
PDF p.3: some numerical questions have no options and the answer is keyed in.
PDF p.3: online mode only; no negative marking for wrong answers.
PDF p.4: cut-off rule: exams held March to August use regulator guidelines and developments up to 31 December; exams held September to February use those up to 30 June.
PDF p.26: battery-operated portable calculator allowed, up to 8 functions and 12 digits; scientific calculators not allowed.
open_points: The illustrative cut-off table on PDF p.4 still shows 2025 sessions. The December 2026 cut-off (30 June 2026) is derived from the general rule on the same page, not from a 2026-specific table.
Six section headings are set in plain type and were inferred as headings (flagged on each topic). The extraction has not been proofread line by line by a person.

sources.title: CAIIB (Certified Associate of IIB&F) web page: examination schedule
sources.note: A live web page; it can change. The saved copy is the evidence for the dates below.
established: May/June 2026 session exam dates: 31 May (ABM), 7 June (BFM), 13 June (ABFM), 14 June (BRBL), 21 June 2026 (electives).
December 2026 session exam dates: 6 Dec (ABM), 12 Dec (BFM), 13 Dec (ABFM), 20 Dec (BRBL), 27 Dec 2026 (electives).

sources.title: Notice: Information and operational guidelines in respect of new set of questions 'Questions without options' from November/December 2023 CAIIB examination
sources.session_applicability: From the November/December 2023 CAIIB examination onward; no later replacement was found on the academics notice page on the retrieval date
established: Questions without options appear in all four compulsory subjects and carry one mark each.
Only digits, a leading minus sign and a decimal point can be keyed in; commas and other characters are not accepted.
Where the number of decimal places is specified, the answer is rounded to that many places (examples: 8.7678 to 8.77, 8.7623 to 8.76, 5.45678 to 5.4568).
An answer that is not saved is treated as not attempted.
open_points: The notice gives rounding examples but does not state a rule for an exact tie (a trailing 5). The app uses half-up rounding for authored answers and must avoid tie cases in questions until that is confirmed.

sources.title: Cut-off date of guidelines/important developments for examinations
sources.session_applicability: Worded for 2024 sessions; shows the same March-August / September-February pattern as the 2026 rules
sources.note: Corroborates the pattern only; it does not itself state 2026 dates.
established: March-August 2024 exams: cut-off 31 December 2023. September 2024-February 2025 exams: cut-off 30 June 2024.
